body:
Promotion 11 (#4075 @ e112ce7) got CHANGES REQUESTED from the codex STRICT review; I ruled all three findings blocking (ruling on STORY-2772 and BUG-2565):
1. integration_cmd.rs zips pass.changes with land::pass rows, but pass() sorts rows by PR number -> wrong row admits a PR. Look up by row.pr == change.id; regression with out-of-order PRs and opposite outcomes.
2. land::changed_paths uses `git diff --name-only` without -z: quoted names bypass the gate/ protected-path check. Use -z / NUL split; regress quoted, newline, Unicode names.
3. BUG-2565 AC2: store_pull_coalesce probes origin/<default> but pull merges origin/<current>; revalidate the selected branch; regress on a non-default branch.
Please fix on integration (LIGHT gate + the four 15:34 tests), push, and tell me the new integration head; I'll update #4075, run full CI, then delta review. Merge hold on #4075 stays until then.
